demo: read-only live call made by the AstraNL maintainers; not a customer job
transport: streamable HTTP, POST, response Content-Type text/event-stream
flow: initialize -> notifications/initialized -> tools/call, stateless, no Mcp-Session-Id issued
trimmed: result_parsed keeps the verdict sections; access_basis, reference and verify instructions omitted

arguments.purpose: read-only documentation demo by the AstraNL maintainers

content.text: <JSON string, parsed and trimmed in result_parsed>

result_parsed.data_policy: verdicts derived from the sources, not register data; read the registration itself at the KVK link

registry.source: KVK Handelsregister, Zoeken API, read live or from a cache of at most 10 minutes

sanctions.source: EU FSD consolidated sanctions list and US Consolidated Screening List

insolvency.meaning: no insolvency publication under this KvK number at checked_at; a bankruptcy takes effect from the start of the day it is declared and can be published later; this says nothing about solvency

name_check.rule: case, punctuation and spacing ignored; one legal-form suffix B.V., BV, N.V., NV, V.O.F., VOF or C.V. at the end ignored; registered names include those of inactive registrations

open_questions: VAT not checked: no vat_number supplied
result_parsed.what_this_proves: what the named official sources returned at observed_at for these inputs, and nothing more
what_this_does_not_prove: who may sign or order for the company
that a bank account or IBAN belongs to it
that a document or email you hold is genuine or was sent by this company
result_parsed.next_permitted_action: attach check_id and this signed result to your own record, then take your step; if open_questions lists anything, stop and ask a human before paying or signing; repeat the check when it is older than your own tolerance, at most 7 days for a payment

record.how: call record_counterparty_check with check_id within 48 hours when a colleague, approver or auditor must verify this later
